name: @sos-2/web-contracts
description: SOS 2.0 product web console view-model contracts (Work Order P1): pure types + pure projection functions for the production shell — mission hero, system condition, shortfall/opportunity, next allowed action, active autonomous work (tasks, body leases, observation status), the overview cards (current change, evidence quality, experiment status, package reuse, recent learning), the first-class state-block model (loading/empty/unknown/unavailable/partial/error) and the navigation/authority-mode view states. Every product view model carries what, why (rationale chain of typed spine trace links), evidence refs, uncertainty, authority and next allowed action, plus an explicit DEMO-vs-LIVE data-source marker so demo fixture state can never render as live state. Zero domain logic, zero DOM dependencies: vocabularies (truth states, trace types, phases, classifications, permissions) are imported from the owning @sos-2/* packages — never redefined. The ./ecology subpath (Work Order P10) adds the package-ecology/history/self-evolution deep view models: the packages-as-composition-surface workspace (contextual applicability, uncertainty, retained failures and assurance obligations visible — never collapsed into a single score; compositions with their OWN independent evidence), the history timeline + revision-diff projections, and the self-evolution projections (process revisions, retained failure memory, learned rules, non-disableable guard state) reading canonical live state through @sos-2/live-store repositories.

scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run --config core/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config ecology/vitest.config.ts
